source_assessment_is_not_phase_completio: The assessment is saved before SourceScratch sealing and final evidence revalidation. Source preparation then rechecks the evidence and fingerprint before projection.

native_domain_validation.components: Six main loops, three measured_domain_resources loops and three identity-comparison loops.
native_domain_validation.note: row_view decodes file and namespace rows. This is a static work estimate, not measured physical disk traffic or proof of the current instruction pointer.

later_projection_candidates: build_object and ordinary_user_issues_windows both request user_paths; user_paths also recomputes canonical parent paths.
After optional whole-inventory cache release, sequential inventory reads and parent lookups share two decoded chunks. Hot parent rows remain cached.
Parent-cache LRU eviction scans cached rows. Actual miss rates and impact are not measured.
Small two-way projection batches preserve resource bounds but add spill, merge and validation I/O.
optimization_rule: Consolidate redundant work only while preserving all existing checks and owner/pin boundaries; qualify changes on the next candidate. Do not alter or restart the active run for these findings.
